hooks.name: Lesson check on lessons.ts save
hooks.description: When frontend/src/lessons.ts is saved, trace every lesson source in CPython with tracer.py and fail if any lesson ends with a status other than "ok" or uses more than 2000 steps.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 1; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then echo "lesson check: .venv/bin/python not found. Create it with: uv venv .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements-dev.txt" >&2; exit 1; fi; out=$(.venv/bin/python frontend/src/py/check_lessons.py 2>&1); code=$?; echo "$out" | tail -40; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then echo "lesson check FAILED (exit $code): a lesson in frontend/src/lessons.ts did not end with status ok within 2000 steps" >&2; exit 1; fi
